principle: Unobserved shops are not continuously simulated. Stock resolves when a shop is viewed and advances by one bounded catch-up transition only when enough time has elapsed.

initial_state.source: deterministic shop seed + catalogue eligibility + size + assortment rules
initial_state.search_behavior: Search may inspect a deterministic initial state or an existing stored snapshot, but does not advance shop state.

observation.persistence: one current snapshot per world + shop

catch_up.mutation_budget: bounded by current snapshot size with deterministic stochastic rounding

replacement.core: normally retained; only small replacement chance after roughly 90 days

catch_up.long_gap_behavior: Regular and occasional stock increasingly forget the prior state; core identity remains anchored.
